notes.title: DragonScales 5: The Frozen Tomb now supports additional languages
notes.content:
We've just completed localization of "DragonScales 5: The Frozen Tomb" to the following languages:
[list]
[*]German
[*]French
[*]Dutch
[*]Spanish
[/list]

The builds for those languages are already live. Additional languages coming soon.
